items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: When they wound up, they had five of us left... Manuel Paul. Oh, some people out of Papa Celestan.

ctx.x: I knocked the tempo off and he goes, da da da da da da da da da da da.

That's enough, take it down there. No other part is after the beats, no da da da da da. That's enough, get out of here. Then he called Franky Deuce and them fellas up there. When they wound up, they had five of us left. I was number one drummer with me. That's where he caught a wall and he thinned that band out. He brought it down to about 40 pieces. They must have had about 100 before he started. And he got it down to 40 pieces. Gilbert Young was in there. Oh, Sidney Montague. Frasier, Joshua Frasier there.…
I saw a big picture of that. How long did you stay in that band then?
